title: GetDataResponse
description: GetDataResponse contains the last successfully published Solana data.

last_published_data.description: The finalized Solana data, if available.

ConsensusOutcome_for_SolanaData.description: The outcome of the consensus algorithm for data with type T

data.description: The data submitted by the messengers

round.description: The round number when the consensus was reached

timestamp.description: The UNIX timestamp in seconds when the consensus was reached

decimals.description: How many decimals in each number above.

guaranteed_usd.description: The value in each custody account represents a total size estimate of all long positions

locked.description: Amount of locked tokens (used by traders) in u<DENOM>. 1<DENOM> = 10^<decimals>u<denom>

SolanaBalance.description: Represents a single asset balance on a Solana account.

amount.description: Amount of the asset on the account balance.

SolanaData.description: SolanaData represents the off-chain data pulled from the Solana blockchain specifically for Jupiter AUM (Assets Under Management) calculation.

aum_usd.description: Jupiter's Assets Under Management value in USD.

custody_assets.description: Slice of CustodyAssets from each Custody

solana_balances.description: Contains information about asset balances on Solana accounts

solana_token_decimals.description: Contains information about token decimals on Solana

solana_token_total_supply.description: Contains information about the total supply of Solana tokens

SolanaTokenDecimals.description: Represents the decimals of a token on Solana.

SolanaTokenTotalSupply.description: Represents the total supply of a token on Solana.
